subject: info-intr
title: INFO.INTR.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Chart on book p. 330 (R(AS)CM(I)-14). INFO-INTR (information interpretation) is the subject; WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the partner. From the subject: AFI (affinity insight) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From AFI: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From DYM-SPT: H-PR and C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: EXT-DYM (extended dynamics).
